subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should Discord retain transport-level conflict retry in addition to the shared reply-session self-heal proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920?
rationale: Sibling channels already recover this error, but whether transient channel retry and persistent shared lifecycle recovery should coexist permanently is an ownership decision that source correctness alone cannot settle.

options.title: Keep complementary layers
options.body: Land a narrow abort-safe Discord retry for transient delivery races and evaluate shared self-heal separately for persistent wedges.

options.title: Centralize recovery only
options.body: Pause this PR and require the shared session layer to fully own Discord recovery without channel-specific retry.

recommendation.title: Keep complementary layers
recommendation.body: Land a narrow abort-safe Discord retry for transient delivery races and evaluate shared self-heal separately for persistent wedges.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans both the Discord processor and shared reply-session lifecycle.
